pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Air Repeater
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: The air repeater and its longer-ranged, two-handed variant are still valued by some for their ability to allow a shooter to fire multiple rounds without needing to stop to reload or crank to a new…
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: The air repeater and its longer-ranged, two-handed variant are still valued by some for their ability to allow a shooter to fire multiple rounds without needing to stop to reload or crank to a new chamber. A typical air repeater magazine holds 6 pellets.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Arquebus
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This is a long gun that offers more range than the average firearm, though the long barrel and ferocious kickback make the weapon particularly unsteady unless a tripod or other stand is used to…
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This is a long gun that offers more range than the average firearm, though the long barrel and ferocious kickback make the weapon particularly unsteady unless a tripod or other stand is used to stabilize it.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Battle Lute
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This reinforced lute is suitable both for use as a handheld musical instrument and for bashing heads should a crowd turn sour.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This reinforced lute is suitable both for use as a handheld musical instrument and for bashing heads should a crowd turn sour. Its strings are finely braided wires that run along its sturdy metal neck. A battle lute adds its item bonus from weapon potency runes (if any) as an item bonus on Performance checks made while using it as an instrument.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Battle Saddle
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: The battle saddle is a special saddle for a mount that has two large, winglike blades.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: The battle saddle is a special saddle for a mount that has two large, winglike blades. These blades normally lie flat alongside the saddle, providing additional protection for the rider, but they can be deployed with a tug on the reins to slash at enemies adjacent to the mount. When using a battle saddle to parry, you can decide whether the circumstance bonus to AC applies to you or to your mount.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Bayonet
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: agile, attached to crossbow or firearm, finesse
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This blade or spike can be attached to a crossbow or firearm but, unlike other attached weapons, can be wielded in one hand as its own weapon.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This blade or spike can be attached to a crossbow or firearm but, unlike other attached weapons, can be wielded in one hand as its own weapon. When used as a separate weapon, it can't benefit from any runes or abilities that function only for attached weapons.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Bec de Corbin
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: A bec de corbin is a spiked polearm that uses a hammer head to help balance the spike.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: A bec de corbin is a spiked polearm that uses a hammer head to help balance the spike. The hammer portion can be used as a secondary striking surface, while the spike or fluke is specially designed to punch through armor and shields.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.cite: Treasure Vault (Remastered) — Equipment: Bec de Corbin

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Black Powder Knuckle Dusters
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: uncommon, combination, concussive, fatal d8, monk
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This pair of knuckle dusters is fitted with an explosive charge of black powder within the hollowed spikes of the weapon and a firing mechanism you hold in your hand while in use.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This pair of knuckle dusters is fitted with an explosive charge of black powder within the hollowed spikes of the weapon and a firing mechanism you hold in your hand while in use.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Equipment: Black Powder Knuckle Dusters

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Bladed Gauntlet
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: uncommon, agile, finesse, free hand, modular
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: A dagger attached to a retractable mechanism is integrated in this gauntlet's dorsum, so a combatant can quickly arm themself with a blade to exploit the weak points in an enemy's armor.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: A dagger attached to a retractable mechanism is integrated in this gauntlet's dorsum, so a combatant can quickly arm themself with a blade to exploit the weak points in an enemy's armor. Switching configurations on the gauntlet reveals or retracts the contained dagger as appropriate. The dagger isn't removable, and thus can't be wielded or etched with runes separately from the gauntlet.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Bladed Scarf
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: uncommon, disarm, finesse, reach, sweep, trip
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: The thin metal plates interwoven throughout this long scarf turn a fashion accessory into a deadly weapon.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: The thin metal plates interwoven throughout this long scarf turn a fashion accessory into a deadly weapon.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Bladesweeper
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: uncommon, disarm, jotunborn, sweep, versatile P
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: Little more than three swords attached to a single hilt, a bladesweeper is a devastating weapon in the hands of a jotunborn warrior.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: Little more than three swords attached to a single hilt, a bladesweeper is a devastating weapon in the hands of a jotunborn warrior.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Blunderbuss
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This weapon fires pellets from a trumpet-shaped barrel, making it an excellent choice for hunting brush fowl or dealing damage within a short, broad area.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This weapon fires pellets from a trumpet-shaped barrel, making it an excellent choice for hunting brush fowl or dealing damage within a short, broad area. Adventuring gunslingers often carry a blunderbuss to deal with swarms of vermin and similar threats.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Boomerang
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: The boomerang is a carved piece of wood designed to curve as it flies through the air, returning to the wielder after a successful throw.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: The boomerang is a carved piece of wood designed to curve as it flies through the air, returning to the wielder after a successful throw.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Bow Staff
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: The bow staff is a whipstaff with a retracting spool of wire inside a metal cap on one end and a hooked protrusion on the other.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: The bow staff is a whipstaff with a retracting spool of wire inside a metal cap on one end and a hooked protrusion on the other. A wielder trained in the weapon's use can quickly spool and attach or detach the wire to transition the weapon between bow and staff functionality.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Butterfly Sword
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: uncommon, agile, disarm, finesse, monk, parry, twin
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This short, single-edged sword typically features a cross guard that helps catch oncoming attacks.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This short, single-edged sword typically features a cross guard that helps catch oncoming attacks. These swords are typically crafted and sold in pairs.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Cane Pistol
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: uncommon, combination, concealable, concussive, fatal d8
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This fashionable cane's handle hides a dueling pistol fired through the thin, painted cap at the bottom of the cane.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This fashionable cane's handle hides a dueling pistol fired through the thin, painted cap at the bottom of the cane.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Chain Sword
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This weapon has a hilt like a longsword attached to several bladed segments connected by chain links.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This weapon has a hilt like a longsword attached to several bladed segments connected by chain links.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Chakri
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: Similar to a chakram, chakri are too light to be wielded in melee but allow the user significantly more control over their throws.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: Similar to a chakram, chakri are too light to be wielded in melee but allow the user significantly more control over their throws. A chakri is small and light enough that up to two can be worn on each wrist; a chakri worn on the wrist is reload 0 instead of reload—.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Clan Pistol
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: Losing or being forced to surrender their clan pistol is a terrible embarrassment for the dwarves that carry them.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: Losing or being forced to surrender their clan pistol is a terrible embarrassment for the dwarves that carry them.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Coat Pistol
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This small pistol is easily concealed inside a jacket or some other article of clothing.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This small pistol is easily concealed inside a jacket or some other article of clothing.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Combat Fishing Pole
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: uncommon, ranged trip, tethered, thrown 20 feet, versatile P
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: The combat fishing pole is a sturdy and flexible pole that can be used as a weapon in melee.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: The combat fishing pole is a sturdy and flexible pole that can be used as a weapon in melee. When a lure is attached to a combat fishing pole, it can be used to make thrown weapon attacks with a range increment of 20 feet, though the lure must then be reeled back in with an Interact action before the weapon can be used at range again (see the tethered trait). The ranged trip, tethered, thrown, and versatile P traits of the combat fishing pole only apply to thrown attacks made with a lure; throwing the pole itself leaves you with no practical way to retrieve it other than moving to its location and picking it up. A combat fishing pole can be used alongside fishing tackle to fish, and it adds its item bonus from weapon potency runes (if any) as an item bonus on checks to fish when used in this manner.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.cite: War of Immortals — Equipment: Combat Fishing Pole

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Combat Lure
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: uncommon, finesse, tethered, thrown 20 feet, training
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: A combat lure is a weighted leather sack at the end of a length of toughened cord and can be used both to bludgeon opponents and signal directions to a trained avian or other animal.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: A combat lure is a weighted leather sack at the end of a length of toughened cord and can be used both to bludgeon opponents and signal directions to a trained avian or other animal.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Corset Knife
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: A favored self-defense weapon among bar and tavern workers, the corset knife has a weighted hilt and a cylindrical, needlelike blade designed to be easily hidden in clothing, but quickly retrieved…
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: A favored self-defense weapon among bar and tavern workers, the corset knife has a weighted hilt and a cylindrical, needlelike blade designed to be easily hidden in clothing, but quickly retrieved in a pinch.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Crescent Cross
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: A crescent cross combines a small scizore with an arm-mounted crossbow apparatus that can hold up to three bolts at a time.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: A crescent cross combines a small scizore with an arm-mounted crossbow apparatus that can hold up to three bolts at a time.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Dagger Pistol
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This weapon, favored by rangers and other wilderness wanderers, takes the form of a stoutly built pistol with a dagger blade attached beneath the barrel and extending out past the muzzle.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This weapon, favored by rangers and other wilderness wanderers, takes the form of a stoutly built pistol with a dagger blade attached beneath the barrel and extending out past the muzzle.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Dancer's Spear
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: backswing, finesse, reach, sweep, versatile B
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: A dancer's spear has a 7-foot-long wooden haft capped with a triangular metal blade at one end, counterbalanced on the other end with a reinforced metal sleeve that, in a pinch, can be used as an…
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: A dancer's spear has a 7-foot-long wooden haft capped with a triangular metal blade at one end, counterbalanced on the other end with a reinforced metal sleeve that, in a pinch, can be used as an effective striking surface.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Dart Umbrella
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This umbrella fires tiny blowgun darts from its ferrule with a twist of the handle.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This umbrella fires tiny blowgun darts from its ferrule with a twist of the handle. The darts are loaded into the shaft, and though the damage they deal is minimal, the dart umbrella is an inconspicuous weapon easy to slip past inspections.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Dawnsilver Tree
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: uncommon, concussive, elf, fatal d10, parry
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: An elegant weapon, a mithral tree does somewhat resemble a tree; its fanned stock and long, sweeping barrel reinforced with metal rings enable a wielder to parry melee attacks while moving back into…
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: An elegant weapon, a mithral tree does somewhat resemble a tree; its fanned stock and long, sweeping barrel reinforced with metal rings enable a wielder to parry melee attacks while moving back into safe firing range.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Double-Barreled Pistol
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: uncommon, concussive, double barrel, fatal d8
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This flintlock pistol has two side-by-side barrels.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This flintlock pistol has two side-by-side barrels. Though less accurate than a standard pistol, a double-barreled pistol is a useful and versatile weapon. It's generally banned in areas where duels with pistols are relatively common, in much the same way that arriving at an aristocratic duel with a scattergun would be considered crass, at best.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Dragon Mouth Pistol
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: Similar to the blunderbuss, a dragon-mouth pistol fires pellets from a flared barrel.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: Similar to the blunderbuss, a dragon-mouth pistol fires pellets from a flared barrel. Though less powerful than a blunderbuss, the dragon-mouth pistol is appreciated for its portability and one-handed design. Though the name was coined because of the destructive belch of this handheld scatter weapon, many gunsmiths craft dragon-mouth pistols with elaborate embellishments that resemble a stylized dragon's maw framing the barrel.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Equipment: Dragon Mouth Pistol

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Dwarven Dorn-Dergar
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: A heavy, weighted cube of metal at the end of a long chain, the dorn-dergar is used by dwarven berserkers and sappers who specialize in breaking through lines of shielded opponents or disabling…
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: A heavy, weighted cube of metal at the end of a long chain, the dorn-dergar is used by dwarven berserkers and sappers who specialize in breaking through lines of shielded opponents or disabling enemy siege weapons.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Earthbreaker
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: razing, shove, two hand d10, versatile P
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This massive hammer's metal head is shaped or molded with heavy metal wedges along its primary striking surface, enabling it to tear through shields and armor with ease.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This massive hammer's metal head is shaped or molded with heavy metal wedges along its primary striking surface, enabling it to tear through shields and armor with ease.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Falcata
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: The falcata is a heavy, one-handed sword with a single cutting edge, usually flaring to be wider toward the point of the weapon and narrower toward the hilt.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: The falcata is a heavy, one-handed sword with a single cutting edge, usually flaring to be wider toward the point of the weapon and narrower toward the hilt.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Fauchard
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: A fauchard is similar to a glaive, save that its cutting edge is along the concave side.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: A fauchard is similar to a glaive, save that its cutting edge is along the concave side.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Feng Huo Lun
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: uncommon, agile, disarm, finesse, monk, parry, twin, versatile P
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: Also known as wind and fire wheels, these large, flat steel rings feature several protruding blades typically stylized to resemble flames.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: Also known as wind and fire wheels, these large, flat steel rings feature several protruding blades typically stylized to resemble flames.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.cite: Treasure Vault (Remastered) — Equipment: Feng Huo Lun

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Fighting Fan
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: uncommon, agile, backstabber, deadly d6, finesse, monk
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This fan is useful for elegant dances as well as for slicing unsuspecting foes with the blades along its outer edge.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This fan is useful for elegant dances as well as for slicing unsuspecting foes with the blades along its outer edge. If used in performances, it might be disguised as a frilly accessory, or it might be an obvious, though elegant, weapon.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Fighting Oar
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: A fighting oar is a sturdy boat oar, typically made of wood, whose haft and blades are reinforced for use in combat.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: A fighting oar is a sturdy boat oar, typically made of wood, whose haft and blades are reinforced for use in combat. A fighting oar adds its item bonus from weapon potency runes (if any) as an item bonus on Piloting Lore and Sailing Lore checks made to pilot a rowed vehicle.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.cite: War of Immortals — Equipment: Fighting Oar

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Fire Lance
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This amazingly simple projectile weapon is nothing more than a metal tube packed with black powder and a stopper, attached to the sharpened head of a javelin.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This amazingly simple projectile weapon is nothing more than a metal tube packed with black powder and a stopper, attached to the sharpened head of a javelin. A loaded fire lance can be wielded as a normal spear, though it requires an Interact action to regrip the weapon and hold it properly when switching from one use to another.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Flingflenser
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: uncommon, backstabber, fatal d10, goblin, scatter 5
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: A flingflenser is a goblin-designed weapon ending in an ovoid tube with a hatch and handle on the narrow end.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: A flingflenser is a goblin-designed weapon ending in an ovoid tube with a hatch and handle on the narrow end. A cluster of circular blades held together and attached to a black powder packet with a thin leather strap serves as ammunition and is loaded through the hatch before being fired with a flintlock or other external ignition mechanism. The flingflenser's sturdy design also places it among the more reliable goblin weapons.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Flintlock Pistol
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: Though less accurate and powerful than a flintlock musket, the flintlock pistol is a preferred weapon of privateers thanks to its more compact size and affordability.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: Though less accurate and powerful than a flintlock musket, the flintlock pistol is a preferred weapon of privateers thanks to its more compact size and affordability. Pirate captains often wear a brace of such pistols in a bandolier so they can draw and fire without stopping to reload.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Flyssa
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This single-edged blade has a guardless hilt.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This single-edged blade has a guardless hilt. Often decorated with elaborate etchings, a flyssa is longer than most daggers but shorter than average for most swords, making it useful in close and pitched combat.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Forked Bipod
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: A forked bipod can be deployed or retrieved for use as a melee weapon as an Interact action.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: A forked bipod can be deployed or retrieved for use as a melee weapon as an Interact action. As with a Tripod, you can change your grip on the weapon as part of this action.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Frying Pan
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: The cast-iron frying pan is an essential tool for adventuring halflings, gold panners, and remote tavern owners.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: The cast-iron frying pan is an essential tool for adventuring halflings, gold panners, and remote tavern owners. Characters with the Halfling Weapon Familiarity ancestry feat are trained in the frying pan.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Gaff
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: These hooked staffs are popular among fishers and warriors alike.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: These hooked staffs are popular among fishers and warriors alike.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Gauntlet Bow
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: The gauntlet bow is a heavy metal glove with a built-in crossbow and rotating chamber mechanism for easy reloading.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: The gauntlet bow is a heavy metal glove with a built-in crossbow and rotating chamber mechanism for easy reloading. A gauntlet bow can be used to make melee attacks like a standard gauntlet, and it retains any valid runes when used as such. You can't reload a gauntlet bow with the hand wielding it.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Gladius
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: Similar to a shortsword, a gladius is designed to inflict deadly stabbing wounds while still being useful as a slashing weapon.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: Similar to a shortsword, a gladius is designed to inflict deadly stabbing wounds while still being useful as a slashing weapon.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Hand Cannon
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: A hand cannon can be used to fire almost anything that can be packed into its barrel.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: A hand cannon can be used to fire almost anything that can be packed into its barrel. The wielder of a hand cannon can change the damage type granted by its modular trait as part of the same Interact action used to reload.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Harmona Gun
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: The gun got its name due to the eerie similarity between the buzzing sound its oversized projectiles make flying through the air and the flight of a fey bird called a harmona.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: The gun got its name due to the eerie similarity between the buzzing sound its oversized projectiles make flying through the air and the flight of a fey bird called a harmona.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Harpoon
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: Often used for hunting exceptionally large aquatic creatures, the harpoon is similar to a javelin but features a barbed head and rope tether so it (or the corpse it's attached to) can be easily…
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: Often used for hunting exceptionally large aquatic creatures, the harpoon is similar to a javelin but features a barbed head and rope tether so it (or the corpse it's attached to) can be easily retrieved.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Hook Sword
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: uncommon, disarm, monk, parry, trip, twin
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This long sword has a hook near the tip, making it easy to snag an opponent or their weapons.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This long sword has a hook near the tip, making it easy to snag an opponent or their weapons.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Injection Spear
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: A hollow receptacle inside this spear's head can store a single dose of poison.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: A hollow receptacle inside this spear's head can store a single dose of poison. A sliding trigger along the spear's shaft can inject the loaded poison into a damaged target.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Jiu Huan Dao
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This sword has a broad blade, along which are threaded nine heavy metal rings, leading some to call it the nine-ring sword.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This sword has a broad blade, along which are threaded nine heavy metal rings, leading some to call it the nine-ring sword. The rings add weight to the weapon for broad swings and clash together to make noise.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.cite: Treasure Vault (Remastered) — Equipment: Jiu Huan Dao

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Karambit
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: uncommon, agile, fatal d8, finesse, versatile S
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This small, curved blade resembles a tiger's claw and is capable of delivering deep wounds.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This small, curved blade resembles a tiger's claw and is capable of delivering deep wounds.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Kestros
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: The kestros is a type of sling that fires special ammunition with wing-shaped fins and a pointed end.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: The kestros is a type of sling that fires special ammunition with wing-shaped fins and a pointed end. The thongs of the sling are of uneven length, one shorter and one several inches longer, around an open loop to cradle the ammunition as the sling is spun.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Knuckle Duster
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This bit of hardened metal, favored by street toughs, is typically made of brass and features four finger holes so that it can sit atop the knuckles, adding extra power to a punch.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This bit of hardened metal, favored by street toughs, is typically made of brass and features four finger holes so that it can sit atop the knuckles, adding extra power to a punch.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Kusarigama
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: uncommon, disarm, monk, reach, trip, versatile B
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This impressive but demanding weapon consists of a weight attached to a kama via a length of chain, which aids with disarming an opponent or attacking from a distance.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This impressive but demanding weapon consists of a weight attached to a kama via a length of chain, which aids with disarming an opponent or attacking from a distance.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Lancer
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This lance has a heavy grip with two parallel crossbow fixtures built into it, making it a useful weapon for combats who prefer to keep their distance at all times.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This lance has a heavy grip with two parallel crossbow fixtures built into it, making it a useful weapon for combats who prefer to keep their distance at all times.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Leiomano
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This thick club is inset with sharp teeth, typically from a shark, that easily tear flesh.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This thick club is inset with sharp teeth, typically from a shark, that easily tear flesh.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Lion Scythe
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: A lion scythe resembles a common sickle but is specially weighted to allow for greater power when attacking.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: A lion scythe resembles a common sickle but is specially weighted to allow for greater power when attacking.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Long Air Repeater
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: Like the one-handed air repeater, this thin-barreled firearm uses a container of pressurized air instead of black powder to propel small metal pellets from an attached cartridge.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: Like the one-handed air repeater, this thin-barreled firearm uses a container of pressurized air instead of black powder to propel small metal pellets from an attached cartridge. The long air repeater has better range and ammo capacity than the one-handed variant, though it still lacks significant stopping power. A typical long air repeater magazine holds 8 pellets.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Equipment: Long Air Repeater

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Long Hammer
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: brace, dwarf, reach, trip, versatile P
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: The long hammer features a pronged hammer head designed for damaging knees and ankles, counterbalanced by a stout spike and affixed to a reinforced shaft between 5 and 7 feet long.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: The long hammer features a pronged hammer head designed for damaging knees and ankles, counterbalanced by a stout spike and affixed to a reinforced shaft between 5 and 7 feet long.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Mace Multipistol
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: uncommon, capacity 3, combination, concussive, fatal d8
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: At first glance this weapon looks like nothing more than an iron-bound club.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: At first glance this weapon looks like nothing more than an iron-bound club. But the top of the weapon features a latch that opens to reveal three rotating pistol muzzles concealed in the mace's head that can be fired and rotated using triggers built into the weapon's haft.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Machete
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This medium-length sword has a wide, gently curved blade and long grip.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This medium-length sword has a wide, gently curved blade and long grip. Though it's typically used to hack through heavy foliage, the machete can also be used as a deadly weapon.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Macuahuitl
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This wooden club is embedded with razor-sharp blades, typically made of obsidian.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This wooden club is embedded with razor-sharp blades, typically made of obsidian. The blades are inserted vertically around two sides of the weapon, leaving a central bludgeoning surface available for bashing.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Maul-spade
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This heavy, club-like weapon can clobber foes, but it also functions as a shovel.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This heavy, club-like weapon can clobber foes, but it also functions as a shovel. A maul-spade adds its item bonus from weapon potency runes (if any) as an item bonus on checks made with Athletics and appropriate Lore skills (such as Labor Lore) when using it as a shovel to dig.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Meteor Hammer
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This weapon consists of a long chain connected to a heavy weight at each end.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This weapon consists of a long chain connected to a heavy weight at each end. When a wielder swings the weights by the chain, they build momentum and can serve as deadly bludgeons with incredible reach.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Mikazuki
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: The mikazuki combines a sansetsukon with a thin length of metal string and several locking mechanisms built into the joints, allowing it to be quickly locked into configuration as a bow.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: The mikazuki combines a sansetsukon with a thin length of metal string and several locking mechanisms built into the joints, allowing it to be quickly locked into configuration as a bow.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Naginata
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: uncommon, deadly d8, reach, versatile P
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This 6-foot staff has a 2-foot-long, slightly curved, swordlike blade attached at one end.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This 6-foot staff has a 2-foot-long, slightly curved, swordlike blade attached at one end. The long pole helps keep the wielder out of reach of swords and shorter weapons.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Nodachi
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: Also known as a zhanmadao, the exceptionally long blade of the nodachi is designed to neutralize enemy mounts and counter the advantages of cavalry units.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: Also known as a zhanmadao, the exceptionally long blade of the nodachi is designed to neutralize enemy mounts and counter the advantages of cavalry units. Its shape and size make it somewhat impractical for close combat but highly effective against charging opponents.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Palstave
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This simple axe is created by inserting a weighted metal wedge into a curved wooden handle with a Y-shaped groove at the top, and then binding the splitting wedge in place with leather thongs.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This simple axe is created by inserting a weighted metal wedge into a curved wooden handle with a Y-shaped groove at the top, and then binding the splitting wedge in place with leather thongs.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Panabas
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This weapon has practical uses in both farming and butchering, thanks to the efficiency and brutality of its forward-curving blade.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This weapon has practical uses in both farming and butchering, thanks to the efficiency and brutality of its forward-curving blade. It can be wielded in one or two hands.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Pantograph Gauntlet
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: uncommon, deadly d6, monk, reach, shove
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: A pantograph gauntlet is a heavy, fist-like weight, mounted on an extendable frame and attached to your outer arm with a series of leather straps.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: A pantograph gauntlet is a heavy, fist-like weight, mounted on an extendable frame and attached to your outer arm with a series of leather straps. The frame's set of mechanical linkages connected at various hinges allow movements to propagate across the frame based on reshaping parallelograms, further controlled by a crossbar grasped in your hand. A pantograph gauntlet is driven by your own motion and mirrors your arm's movements-a punch thrown with your fist moves the pantograph, extending the weight out at a rapid speed to land blows up to 10 feet away.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Pepperbox
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: The pepperbox has three barrels that each hold a single shot, and the shooter can manually rotate the whole barrel assembly to align a loaded barrel with the firing mechanism.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: The pepperbox has three barrels that each hold a single shot, and the shooter can manually rotate the whole barrel assembly to align a loaded barrel with the firing mechanism.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Piercing Wind
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: uncommon, combination, concussive, fatal aim d10
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: Additionally, it's fitted with an underslung curved blade.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: Additionally, it's fitted with an underslung curved blade.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Rapier Pistol
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: uncommon, backstabber, combination, concussive, fatal d8
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This elegant weapon is shaped similarly to a rapier with a pistol down the length of the blade.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This elegant weapon is shaped similarly to a rapier with a pistol down the length of the blade.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Reinforced Stock

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: A reinforced stock is a weighted crossbow, firearm haft, or grip customized for striking in melee.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: A reinforced stock is a weighted crossbow, firearm haft, or grip customized for striking in melee.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Rope Dart
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: uncommon, disarm, finesse, sweep, tethered, thrown 20 feet, trip
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: A deceptively simple weapon made from a length of cord attached to a weighted, conical metal spike.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: A deceptively simple weapon made from a length of cord attached to a weighted, conical metal spike. A rope dart can be whirled and manipulated at great speeds to attack in unexpected ways and from unexpected angles.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Rotary Bow
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This one-handed crossbow has four arms instead of two, and four rotating chambers that can be pre-loaded with bolts for more efficient firing.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This one-handed crossbow has four arms instead of two, and four rotating chambers that can be pre-loaded with bolts for more efficient firing. The chamber can be swapped and the arms redrawn with a simple crank device built into the crossbow.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Sansetsukon
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: The sansetsukon, also known as a sanjiegun or three-section staff, is made up of three wooden staff segments, each about 14 inches in length.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: The sansetsukon, also known as a sanjiegun or three-section staff, is made up of three wooden staff segments, each about 14 inches in length. The staff sections are connected by short lengths of cord or chain, similar to nunchaku.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Scizore
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: A scizore is a gauntlet or protective leather tube worn over the forearm and featuring a half-moon blade mounted to the end of the cap on a short pole.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: A scizore is a gauntlet or protective leather tube worn over the forearm and featuring a half-moon blade mounted to the end of the cap on a short pole.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Scourge
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: A scourge—also known as a cat-o'-nine-tails—is a set of several knotted cords made from cotton or leather and attached to a handle.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: A scourge—also known as a cat-o'-nine-tails—is a set of several knotted cords made from cotton or leather and attached to a handle. While most scourges are more suitable for torture than combat, when fashioned into a weapon, a scourge can have metal barbs woven into the cords to pierce clothing and armor.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Shield Bow
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: As the name implies, a shield bow is a bow with an integrated shielding surface.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: As the name implies, a shield bow is a bow with an integrated shielding surface. While versatile and effective, a shield bow's architecture limits its flexibility somewhat, decreasing its total draw strength and penetrating power.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Tekko-Kagi
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: uncommon, agile, disarm, finesse, free hand, monk, parry
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: Four curved blades attached to a sturdy handlebar give the wielder of this close-combat weapon the illusion of having claws that extend from their fist.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: Four curved blades attached to a sturdy handlebar give the wielder of this close-combat weapon the illusion of having claws that extend from their fist.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Umbrella Injector
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This umbrella's ferrule is a hollow-tipped blade three to four inches in length and often overlooked as decorative.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This umbrella's ferrule is a hollow-tipped blade three to four inches in length and often overlooked as decorative. A receptacle inside the umbrella's shaft can be loaded with a single dose of injury poison and injected into a damaged target with the pull of a sliding trigger. Reinforced ribs enable you to parry and deflect blows with the umbrella's tear-resistant canopy.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Urumi
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: A bouquet of whiplike blades extends from the hilt of this sword, enabling deadly, sweeping attacks.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: A bouquet of whiplike blades extends from the hilt of this sword, enabling deadly, sweeping attacks.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: War Gavel
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: A war gavel is similar in construction to a palstave axe, but instead of inserting a metal wedge, it uses a heavier wooden head that is either carved into several points or inset with pointed…
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: A war gavel is similar in construction to a palstave axe, but instead of inserting a metal wedge, it uses a heavier wooden head that is either carved into several points or inset with pointed objects like the teeth of large mammals.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.cite: War of Immortals — Equipment: War Gavel

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: War Javelin
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: A war javelin is similar to a standard javelin, but made of sturdier woods with additional leather grips to make it suitable as a melee weapon and a leather thong to retrieve it after it's thrown.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: A war javelin is similar to a standard javelin, but made of sturdier woods with additional leather grips to make it suitable as a melee weapon and a leather thong to retrieve it after it's thrown.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: War Lance
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: uncommon, deadly d8, jousting d6, parry, shove
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This lance appears shorter and stockier in comparison to other weapons of its type.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This lance appears shorter and stockier in comparison to other weapons of its type. The war lance notably features shielding integrated into its vamplate, exchanging its reach for a sturdier base when defending against attacks or attempting to overpower an opponent.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: War Razor
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: A war razor is an exaggerated version of the barbers' tool.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: A war razor is an exaggerated version of the barbers' tool. It's a brittle but extremely sharp weapon that is very easy to slip into a pocket or sleeve.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Whipstaff
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: uncommon, agile, finesse, monk, parry, sweep
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: The whipstaff is a 5-foot-long staff carved from alchemically treated wood.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: The whipstaff is a 5-foot-long staff carved from alchemically treated wood. Exceptionally light and well-balanced, whipstaffs are favored by travelers and martial artists who prioritize speed over power.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Wrecker
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: uncommon, combination, dwarf, ranged trip, razing
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: The wrecker combines a dwarven dorn-dergar with a heavy, gear-reinforced arm cover that allows it to be fired like an oversized sling, then retrieved and reloaded by manually activating a clockwork…
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: The wrecker combines a dwarven dorn-dergar with a heavy, gear-reinforced arm cover that allows it to be fired like an oversized sling, then retrieved and reloaded by manually activating a clockwork spool. A wrecker must be loaded to be switched from its ranged configuration to its melee configuration.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Alchemical Gauntlet
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: An alchemical gauntlet emits small alchemical detonations when it makes contact with a foe.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: An alchemical gauntlet emits small alchemical detonations when it makes contact with a foe. As an Interact action, you can place a bomb into a metal bracket near the wrist of the gauntlet. The bomb must be one that deals energy damage, such as an acid flask, alchemist's fire, blasting stone, bottled lightning, or frost vial. The next three attacks made with the gauntlet deal 1d4 damage of the bomb's damage type in addition to the gauntlet's normal damage. If the second and third attacks aren't all made within 1 minute of the first attack, the bomb's energy is wasted. These attacks never deal splash damage or other special effects of the bomb and aren't modified by any abilities that add to or modify a bomb's effect.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Axe Musket
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This item, favored by firearms-using dwarves and barbarians, takes the form of a sturdy musket that combine the functionality of melee weapons and with an axe blade attached near the muzzle.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This item, favored by firearms-using dwarves and barbarians, takes the form of a sturdy musket that combine the functionality of melee weapons and with an axe blade attached near the muzzle.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Backpack Ballista
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This complex wooden device, worn on the back, contains a miniature ballista on a retractable arm.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This complex wooden device, worn on the back, contains a miniature ballista on a retractable arm. As an Interact action, you can pull a lever to deploy or retract the ballista. As long as it remains deployed, you must hold the ballista using that hand or some of the components spill out onto the ground, just like dropping any other weapon. While deployed, the device opens and raises the ballista up over your shoulder. While retracted, the ballista and its mount slide down and are concealed within the device. Although a backpack ballista packs a punch, the device is a challenge to operate. Reloading it takes 1 minute and can't be done while worn. As normal, you can't wear a backpack ballista with another backpack.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Backpack Catapult
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This wooden device is worn on the back and contains a miniature catapult mounted on a retractable frame.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This wooden device is worn on the back and contains a miniature catapult mounted on a retractable frame. As an Interact action, you can pull a lever to deploy or retract the catapult. As long as it remains deployed, you must hold the catapult using that hand or some of the components spill out onto the ground, just like dropping any other weapon. While deployed, the device opens and raises the catapult up over your shoulder. While retracted, the catapult and its mount slide down and are concealed within the device. A backpack catapult fires specialized stone spheres that are loaded into the bucket while unworn and retracted, through a sliding hatch; the reloading process takes 1 minute. To prevent misfires and accidental injury, the bucket fully encloses the stone while deployed, only opening when fired. As normal, you can't wear a backpack catapult with another backpack.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Barricade Buster

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: A barricade buster fires spheres of metal with extreme velocity and very little accuracy.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: A barricade buster fires spheres of metal with extreme velocity and very little accuracy.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Big Boom Gun
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: uncommon, cobbled, fatal d12, goblin, modular
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: Developed by a goblin weaponsmith who missed the "hand" part of "hand cannon," this comically oversized gun has a heavily reinforced barrel and is loaded with a worrisome quantity of gunpowder.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description:
Developed by a goblin weaponsmith who missed the "hand" part of "hand cannon," this comically oversized gun has a heavily reinforced barrel and is loaded with a worrisome quantity of gunpowder. This hand cannon is a martial weapon instead of a simple weapon. It has the fatal d12 trait and a range increment of 20 feet. It also has the following modified critical failure condition.

**Critical Failure** The attack misses, the weapon misfires, and you take 1d12 fire damage as it explodes in your face.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Equipment: Big Boom Gun

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Double-Barreled Musket
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: uncommon, concussive, double barrel, fatal d10
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This flintlock breech-loader has two side-by-side barrels.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This flintlock breech-loader has two side-by-side barrels. Though less accurate than a standard musket, a double-barreled musket offers versatility in firing options.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Dueling Pistol
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: Made for settling disputes when diplomacy fails, dueling pistols are finely crafted and made to fit easily into a holster or pocket.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: Made for settling disputes when diplomacy fails, dueling pistols are finely crafted and made to fit easily into a holster or pocket.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Dwarven Scattergun
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: A dwarven scattergun fires a large paper cartridge stuffed with black powder and knuckle-sized lumps of metal, creating a devastating burst so destructive that a foolish dwarf might find themself…
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: A dwarven scattergun fires a large paper cartridge stuffed with black powder and knuckle-sized lumps of metal, creating a devastating burst so destructive that a foolish dwarf might find themself catching painful ricochets when firing at a too-close target. Some scatterguns are crafted with a clockwork firing tray that can quickly sort and load black powder and shot without needing a prepackaged cartridge, though this is largely an aesthetic feature with no real mechanical benefit.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Explosive Dogslicer
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: uncommon, backstabber, combination, fatal d10, goblin, scatter 5
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: An explosive dogslicer is a sneaky, explosive weapon that often brings perverse joy to the goblins who use them.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: An explosive dogslicer is a sneaky, explosive weapon that often brings perverse joy to the goblins who use them. At first glance, it appears to be a triple-bladed dogslicer with an oversized guard.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Gnome Amalgam Musket
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: uncommon, combination, concussive, fatal d10, gnome
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: Rumored to be the result of a gnomish dare to make a variant of a hooked hammer that's even more intricate and complex, this weapon adds a musket to the mix of an already overcomplicated device.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: Rumored to be the result of a gnomish dare to make a variant of a hooked hammer that's even more intricate and complex, this weapon adds a musket to the mix of an already overcomplicated device.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Equipment: Gnome Amalgam Musket

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Gun Sword
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This weapon consists of a large sword with a powerful gun based on a harmona gun down the center.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This weapon consists of a large sword with a powerful gun based on a harmona gun down the center. Vanguards and other characters who rely on Strength and Dexterity enjoy the power and flexibility of a gun sword.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Hammer Gun
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This weapon, favored by dwarves and those who like smashing and shooting, takes the form of a stoutly built gun designed similarly to an arquebus with a hammer head built into the muzzle, decreasing…
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This weapon, favored by dwarves and those who like smashing and shooting, takes the form of a stoutly built gun designed similarly to an arquebus with a hammer head built into the muzzle, decreasing kickback but limiting range.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Jezail
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: Though lacking the range and stopping power of an arquebus or the raw force of a harmona gun, the jezail is an elegant, well-balanced weapon suitable for a variety of combat situations.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: Though lacking the range and stopping power of an arquebus or the raw force of a harmona gun, the jezail is an elegant, well-balanced weapon suitable for a variety of combat situations. It's even possible to tuck it under one arm to fire a less accurate attack that uses only one hand.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Phalanx Piercer
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: concussive, hobgoblin, propulsive, razing, volley 30 feet
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This massive bow is made from bone or wood reinforced with flexible metal strips and strung with reinforced cord.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This massive bow is made from bone or wood reinforced with flexible metal strips and strung with reinforced cord. Designed by hobgoblin engineers to take down shielded opponents, the phalanx piercer fires heavy, iron-shod bolts.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Polytool
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: The polytool is a small metal rod with a number of simple tools folded inside.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: The polytool is a small metal rod with a number of simple tools folded inside. The user can extend a long ceramic blade, as well as an awl, chisel, file, flint and steel, hook, inkpen, magnifying glass, pliers, scissors, and a small saw. The flint and steel can be used up to 10 times before needing to be replaced.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Repeating Hand Crossbow
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This handheld crossbow features an ingeniously designed catch mechanism at the top of the flight groove, just in front of the latch, which automatically loads a bolt from a magazine and resets the…
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: This handheld crossbow features an ingeniously designed catch mechanism at the top of the flight groove, just in front of the latch, which automatically loads a bolt from a magazine and resets the string each time the weapon is fired. A typical repeating hand crossbow magazine holds five bolts.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Skunk Bomb (Lesser)
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: alchemical, bomb, consumable, olfactory, poison, splash
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: Skunk bombs are made from the concentrated odors of xulgaths, hezrous, and other creatures with natural or supernatural stench.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description:
**Activate** ◆ Strike

Skunk bombs are made from the concentrated odors of xulgaths, hezrous, and other creatures with natural or supernatural stench. The bomb deals 1d4 poison damage and 1 poison splash damage. Any creature hit by the bomb or in its splash area must attempt a DC 15 Fortitude saving throw. Creatures in the splash area treat the results of their saving throw as one step better.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target is Sickened 1.

**Failure** The target is sickened 1 and Slowed 1 while sickened.

**Critical Failure** The target is blinded for 1 round, Sickened 2, and slowed 1 while sickened.

Creatures sickened by the bomb emit an odor that lasts 10 minutes after the sickened condition ends (or 1 hour if they were also blinded). The odor can be removed or neutralized by using prestidigitation or similar magic or by spending 10 minutes scrubbing with ample soap and water. While the odor lasts, creatures within 30 feet can smell the target, enabling even those with a weak sense of smell to detect its presence, and all creatures gain a +1 item bonus to Track the affected creature for as long as it has the odor. A creature that has imprecise or precise scent doubles the range at which it can detect the target using this scent.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: Also known as a harmonica gun, this weapon is essentially a stock, trigger, and firing mechanism attached to a sliding brace of barrels that can each hold a round of ammunition.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Spoon Gun

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description:
No one's entirely certain who developed the spoon gun, but all authorities agree that it was probably a goblin. Essentially a terrible idea in firearm form, the spoon gun is a spring-powered hand cannon with a modified grip that uses miscellaneous knives, forks, chopsticks, and spoons as ammunition. Users typically upend the entire contents of their cutlery drawer into the gun, aim it in the general direction of the foe, and hope it hits something.

This hand cannon is a martial weapon, instead of a simple weapon. It has the scatter (5 feet) trait and uses cutlery or similar-sized objects as ammunition instead of bullets (enough cheap cutlery to fire ten shots costs 1 sp).

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description:
**Perception** +11; precise vision 30 feet, imprecise hearing 30 feet

**Communication** speech (Common)

**Skills** Nature +9, Performance +10, Survival +11

**Int** +0, **Wis** +2, **Cha** +3

**Will** +11

Possessing a boisterous, proud demeanor, this *+1 jezail* is an aspiring big game hunter, always quick to share a tale of its bold adventures and predatory conquests—although the veracity of such tales is often questionable. A *boastful hunter* enjoys tracking and hunting animals of all kinds but takes particular pleasure in taking down large, dangerous, or rare animals. Against an animal, the boastful hunter deals 1d6 additional damage. On a critical hit against an animal, the boastful hunter also deals 1d6 persistent bleed damage.

A *boastful hunter* urges you to face off against tougher and tougher creatures—a challenge the ambitious rifle may not be adequate to deal with. If the *boastful hunter* goes one week without participating in a hunt against an animal of at least your level, it becomes bored. A bored *boastful hunter* complains incessantly and imposes a –1 item penalty to attack rolls against non-animal targets. A bored *boastful hunter* can be appeased by using it in combat against an animal of at least your level.

Unable to accept its own weaknesses, a *boastful hunter* blames any failed hunts on you, and considers remarks about its strength or quality a terrible insult. An insulted *boastful hunter* badmouths you to sentient creatures you interact with, imposing a –1 item penalty to Deception, Diplomacy, and Intimidation skill checks, and all attacks with it incur a misfire chance until the weapon is appeased. An insulted *boastful hunter* can be appeased by complimenting it and succeeding at a DC 21 Diplomacy check against its Will DC two days in a row. You can only attempt a Diplomacy check to appease the *boastful hunter* once each day.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description:
A *ghoul stiletto* is a *+1 dagger* wrapped in the still-undead skin of a ghoul. While you wield the dagger, you gain a +1 status bonus to all saves against curses and olfactory effects.

**Activate** ◆ (concentrate, divine, manipulate, olfactory)

**Frequency** once per hour

**Effect** The ghoul stiletto afflicts the next living target struck by the dagger with a terrible wound that emits the foul stench of the grave. The creature emits a stench aura in a 10-foot emanation for 1 minute. During that time, the affected creature, as well as any creature that starts or ends its turn in the aura, must succeed at a DC 17 Fortitude save or become Sickened 1 (plus Slowed 1 as long as it's sickened on a critical failure). A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune to all stench auras for 1 minute.

**Craft Requirements** The initial raw materials must include skin from a ghoul.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Skunk Bomb (Moderate)
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: alchemical, bomb, consumable, olfactory, poison, splash
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: Skunk bombs are made from the concentrated odors of xulgaths, hezrous, and other creatures with natural or supernatural stench.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description:
**Activate** ◆ Strike

Skunk bombs are made from the concentrated odors of xulgaths, hezrous, and other creatures with natural or supernatural stench. The bomb grants a +1 item bonus to attack rolls and deals 2d4 poison damage and 2 poison splash damage. Any creature hit by the bomb or in its splash area must attempt a DC 17 Fortitude saving throw. Creatures in the splash area treat the results of their saving throw as one step better.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target is Sickened 1.

**Failure** The target is sickened 1 and Slowed 1 while sickened.

**Critical Failure** The target is blinded for 1 round, Sickened 2, and slowed 1 while sickened.

Creatures sickened by the bomb emit an odor that lasts 10 minutes after the sickened condition ends (or 1 hour if they were also blinded). The odor can be removed or neutralized by using prestidigitation or similar magic or by spending 10 minutes scrubbing with ample soap and water. While the odor lasts, creatures within 30 feet can smell the target, enabling even those with a weak sense of smell to detect its presence, and all creatures gain a +1 item bonus to Track the affected creature for as long as it has the odor. A creature that has imprecise or precise scent doubles the range at which it can detect the target using this scent.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: A drake rifle is a firearm made from the saliva glands of a drake.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description:
A drake rifle is a firearm made from the saliva glands of a drake. The firearm launches small bursts of empowered spittle instead of typical rounds of ammunition. A drake rifle is a +1 weapon. It's a distinct type of martial firearm that deals 1d10 acid damage with a range increment of 150 feet and reload 1. On a critical hit, the spittle clings to the target and they take persistent damage of the same type as the weapon equal to 1d4 + the number of weapon damage dice. A drake rifle does not add critical specialization effects.

**Activate—Drake Shot** ◆◆◆ (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** You fire a large, specialized burst designed to hamper your foes. Make a ranged Strike with the drake rifle. As long as the Strike isn't a critical failure, the drake rifle deals 1 splash damage per weapon damage die to the target and creatures within 5 feet of the target. This splash damage is of the same type as its normal damage.

On a hit, the drake rifle provides one of the following additional effects based on its damage type:

- **Acid** Clinging acid makes it painful and sickening to move. The target becomes Sickened 1.

**Craft Requirements** The initial raw materials must include the saliva glands of a ritually hunted drake with a breath weapon that deals the appropriate damage type for the drake rifle

You can make the lance glow like a torch or suppress its light by using an action, which has the concentrate trait.

**Activate** ◆◆ (magical, manipulate)

**Frequency** once per hour

**Craft Requirements** The initial raw materials must include a horn willingly gifted by a unicorn. In rare instances, an alicorn lance can be made with a forcibly taken horn. This imperious *+1 striking mace* has a glowing orb in the shape of an eye set in its flanged head. When you succeed at a check to Recall Knowledge about a creature after you've dealt damage to it with the auspicious scepter, you learn one of its resistances in addition to any other information.

**Activate—Fortunate Strike** ◇ (concentrate)

**Frequency** once every 10 minutes

**Trigger** Your previous action was to Cast a fortune Spell that targeted a single ally

**Effect** Your luck magic lingers, allowing your target to find a weak spot in an enemy's defenses. The next Strike made by the target of the triggering fortune spell bypasses an amount of resistance equal to the spell's rank. This benefit is lost if it isn't used by the end of your next turn. If more than one type of resistance would apply against the attack, the attack bypasses only one—whichever would result in the highest amount of damage getting through, as determined by the GM.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Chainbreaker
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: The head of this +1 striking pick is adorned with a detailed etching of an eagle with outstretched wings.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description:
The head of this *+1 striking pick* is adorned with a detailed etching of an eagle with outstretched wings. When you use it to Strike an unattended object whose intended purpose is to restrain or confine, such as a pair of manacles or the bars of a prison cell, you ignore the first 5 points of the object's Hardness.

**Activate—Liberating Strike** ◆◆

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** You Strike a creature with the *chainbreaker*. If you hit and deal damage, one grabbed or restrained ally within 60 feet of the target can use a reaction to attempt to Escape.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Dazzling Shortbow
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This +1 striking shortbow is a favorite of mage hunters and those who frequently fight enemies who can turn themselves invisible.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description:
This *+1 striking shortbow* is a favorite of mage hunters and those who frequently fight enemies who can turn themselves invisible. A creature who is critically hit with a ranged Strike from a *dazzling shortbow* must succeed at a DC 19 Fortitude save or be dazzled for 1 minute.

**Activate—Show Yourself!** ◆◆ (concentrate)

**Frequency** once per day

**Effect** You fire an arrow that glows with purple light at a spot. Each creature in a 10-foot burst within 60 feet is affected by Revealing Light (DC 19).

**Craft Requirements** Supply one casting of *revealing light*.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Dog-Bone Knife
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.traits: uncommon, agile, finesse, thrown 10 feet, versatile S
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: The blade of this +1 striking dagger is made from the thigh bone of a canine that died in the act of protecting its master.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description: The blade of this *+1 striking dagger* is made from the thigh bone of a canine that died in the act of protecting its master. A werecreature or other creature willingly under the effects of a non-permanent polymorph effect damaged by a *dog-bone knife* must succeed at a DC 19 Will save or immediately revert to its natural form-this has no effect on a creature unwillingly polymorphed. On a successful save, the creature is temporarily immune to this effect for 1 minute. Kushtakas and other creatures vulnerable to canines take a -2 circumstance penalty to saves against this effect, and this weapon overcomes any resistance such creatures have to physical attacks.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Hydrocannon
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This +1 striking hand cannon is crafted by wrapping the water-producing organ cluster of a grodair around its barrel, eliminating the need for ammunition, though the living tissue must be maintained…
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description:
This *+1 striking hand cannon* is crafted by wrapping the water-producing organ cluster of a grodair around its barrel, eliminating the need for ammunition, though the living tissue must be maintained with 1 sp of specialized nutrient feed each day. If not, its misfire check is DC 10 flat. If you fail this misfire check, the organ bursts, dealing an amount of bludgeoning damage equal to double the number of weapon damage dice to you and rendering the *hydrocannon* broken.

**Activate—Tinker Shot** ◆◆ (manipulation)

**Frequency** once per minute

**Effect** You fiddle with the pressure regulator on the *hydrocannon* and then make a ranged Strike with the gun. A successful attack has an additional effect depending on which modular configuration the *hydrocannon* is currently in.

- **Bludgeoning** The target is pushed 5 feet away from you; this forced movement is increased to 10 feet on a critical hit.
- **Piercing** The target takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round.
- **Slashing** The target takes 1d6 bleed damage.

**Craft Requirements** The initial raw materials must include the extradimensional organ cluster extracted from a grodair. Harvesting the organs of a grodair in this way differs greatly from the normal method; it takes an hour and a successful DC 22 Arcana check. On a critical failure, the organ cluster bursts and deals 4d6 bludgeoning damage to the harvester.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.cite: Howl of the Wild — Equipment: Hydrocannon

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Phantom Fang
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This +1 standard-grade cold iron kama is shrouded in spectral mist, leaving behind shimmering afterimages when swung.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description:
This *+1 standard-grade cold iron kama* is shrouded in spectral mist, leaving behind shimmering afterimages when swung.

**Activate—Phantom Dodge** ↺

**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You're targeted by a ranged attack, and you're aware of the attacker

**Effect** Your body becomes temporarily shrouded in mist, causing you to become concealed against the triggering attack.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Pick of Arcane Accuracy
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: The metal head of this +1 striking pick glows faintly, intensifying around the tip.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description:
The metal head of this *+1 striking pick* glows faintly, intensifying around the tip. The hilt features a grip wrapped in deep-blue leather and is carved with a hawk's wings.

**Activate—Mystic Strike** ◆

**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Requirements** Your last action was to Cast a non-cantrip Spell

**Effect** You make a melee Strike with the pick that overflows with magical energy. You gain a +1 status bonus to this Strike, and if you hit, you deal an additional 1d4 persistent force damage.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.cite: Impossible Magic — Equipment: Pick of Arcane Accuracy

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Scizore of the Crab
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: A scizore of the crab is a +1 scizore that has the grapple trait in addition to its normal weapon traits.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description:
A *scizore of the crab* is a *+1 scizore* that has the grapple trait in addition to its normal weapon traits.

**Activate** ◆ (manipulate)

**Requirements** Your last action was a successful Strike with this weapon, or you have a creature grabbed with this weapon

**Effect** The target is grabbed until the end of your next turn. A grabbed creature can use the Escape action to get out of the Grab, and the Grab ends for a grabbed creature if you move away from it. This functions as the Grab creature ability.

**Activate** ◆ (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per round

**Requirements** You have a creature grabbed with this weapon

**Effect** The crab claw animates and pinches open and shut, dealing slashing damage equal to the *scizore of the crab*'s number of damage dice.

**Craft Requirements** The initial raw materials must include a claw from a giant crab or similar creature.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.cite: Treasure Vault (Remastered) — Equipment: Scizore of the Crab

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Shard of Self-Destruction
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This jagged shard of bone appears to be and functions as a +1 striking dagger with a sharp edge that is perpetually stained with blood.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description:
This jagged shard of bone appears to be and functions as a *+1 striking dagger* with a sharp edge that is perpetually stained with blood. Whenever you critically hit with the weapon, you deal an additional 1d6 persistent bleed damage, but you also take 1d6 persistent bleed damage.

Once the curse has activated for the first time, the weapon fuses to you; while you can sheathe the dagger outside of combat, it appears in your hand when a fight begins and you can't sheathe it as long as there is an enemy you can perceive.

**Saving Throw** DC 22 Fortitude

**Onset** 1 hour

**Stage 1** Enfeebled 1 (1 day)

**Stage 2** Enfeebled 2, fatigued, and 1d6 spirit damage each time you would take persistent bleed damage (1 week)

**Stage 3** as stage 2, but the spirit damage increases to 2d6 (1 week)

**Stage 4** Enfeebled 3, fatigued, and 4d6 spirit damage each time you would take persistent bleed damage (1 week)

**Stage 5** death
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.cite: War of Immortals — Equipment: Shard of Self-Destruction

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Solar Shellflower
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This +1 striking flintlock musket features multiple triangular panels that can be folded out of the stock, like the petals of a tigridia flower, that collect sunlight and feed it into the spark…
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description:
This *+1 striking flintlock musket* features multiple triangular panels that can be folded out of the stock, like the petals of a tigridia flower, that collect sunlight and feed it into the spark gun's core. All damage dealt by a *solar shellflower* is fire damage.

**Activate** ◆ (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per day (but see below)

**Effect** One of the panels from the *solar shellflower* detaches and unfurls into a tigridia-shaped construct of flame. For the next 1 minute, whenever you Strike an enemy with the *solar shellflower*, the construct fires a smaller jet of fire that automatically hits the target, dealing 3d4 additional persistent fire damage or twice that on a critical hit. The *solar shellflower* usually requires a full day to replenish enough solar energy to recharge this Activation, but if used in an environment with especially strong sunlight, such as in a desert, cliff above the clouds, or near the summer solstice, it can recharge in 1 hour instead.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Thundercrasher
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: While looking straight down the barrel of this +1 striking blunderbuss, the spark gun's magical core is visible amid several reflectors.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description:
While looking straight down the barrel of this *+1 striking blunderbuss*, the spark gun's magical core is visible amid several reflectors. All damage dealt by a thundercrasher is sonic damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed at a Fortitude save against your class DC or be deafened for 1 minute.

**Activate** ◆◆ (manipulate)

**Frequency** once per hour

**Effect** You overload the *thundercrasher* to emit chaotic sonic frequencies that soften earth and stone. When you next fire the *thundercrasher* it also partially liquefies any natural earth or stone surfaces within range of its scatter trait, making the area difficult terrain.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Trollhound Pick
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This +1 striking greatpick bears a head studded with the tusks of a trollhound.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description:
This *+1 striking greatpick* bears a head studded with the tusks of a trollhound.

**Activate—Ravenous Strike** ◆◆ (magical, manipulate)

**Effect** You Strike with the *trollhound pick*, transferring a portion of a trollhound's legendary appetite to the target. A living enemy who takes damage from the attack must attempt a DC 19 Will save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature suffers hunger pangs, becoming off-guard for 1 round.

**Failure** The creature experiences gnawing hunger, becoming off-guard for 1 round and Enfeebled 1 for 1 minute. If the creature consumes any amount of food or drink (including imbibing a potion), the enfeebled condition ends.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the creature is Enfeebled 2 and each instance of consuming food or drink reduces the penalty by 1.

**Craft Requirements** The initial raw materials must include the teeth and tongue from a trollhound.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.cite: Howl of the Wild — Equipment: Trollhound Pick

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Accursed Staff
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: Iron strips line the body of an accursed staff, capping the bottom and folding into an intricate knot at the top.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description:
Iron strips line the body of an *accursed staff*, capping the bottom and folding into an intricate knot at the top. While wielding an *accursed staff*, you're empowered by the curses you inflict. If an enemy fails a saving throw against a spell you cast that has the curse trait, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to double that spell's rank. These temporary Hit Points last 10 minutes. The enemy must be a significant threat and can't have been a willing subject of the curse.

**Activate** Cast a Spell

**Effect** You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.

- **Cantrip** Daze
- **1st** Bane, Ill Omen
- **2nd** Blood Vendetta, Warrior's Regret

**Craft Requirements** Supply one casting of all listed ranks of all listed spells.

pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.name: Arboreal's Revenge
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.summary: This walnut and brass +1 striking blunderbuss has a natural look, with wood worn smooth by time, but left knotted and gnarled.
pf2e-orc.equipment.weapons.description:
This walnut and brass *+1 striking blunderbuss* has a natural look, with wood worn smooth by time, but left knotted and gnarled. The handgrip beneath the flared muzzle is a well-positioned bulging tree knot, and the long stock looks as if it was grown to fit you. On closer examination, the whorls and rings in the wood resemble eyes.
